# History rewrite of 2026-11-25

One commit on the unpublished part of the `origami-re` branch contained a link to a private host. The history from that commit onward was rewritten to remove it, so every commit from there on has a new hash, with the same author, author date, message and content except for that one line.
The table maps each old hash to its new one, in order; commits before the first listed one were not changed. The one later commit that fixed the same line became empty and was dropped.
The old commits stay reachable in the private repository under `refs/archive/pre-rewrite-20261125`, which is not published.
